name: Kepler-5
description: Star of 6,297 K, 900 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: Kepler-5
quotes.card: Kepler-5 is a star located in the constellation Cygnus in the field of view of the Kepler Mission, a NASA project aimed at detecting planets in transit of, or passing in front of, their host stars as seen from Earth.
quotes.introduction: One closely-orbiting, Jupiter-like planet, named Kepler-5b, has been detected around Kepler-5.
